spec_match.rationale: Runs the exact shipping pipeline (MSE addSourceBuffer/appendBuffer with the spec-form string iamf.000.000.Opus muxed with avc1.640028) against the same asset Chromium's MSE_BasicPlayback_Iamf_Stereo integration test plays.

interactive.rationale: One button drives the six-rung ladder with per-rung live outcomes, a visible video element with controls, and a real downloadable asset.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises a real playback attempt that stops honestly where the browser stops; the verified behaviour is exactly a rung-1 stop on the test browser.

edge_cases.rationale: No-MediaSource, probe-false, fetch failure, addSourceBuffer throw, autoplay rejection, and decode-after-positive-probe divergence all have distinct honest branches — but rungs 2-6 could not be executed in any available browser, so those branches are code-reviewed and syntax-loaded rather than runtime-proven.

references.rationale: Links ChromeStatus, the spec's ISO-BMFF encapsulation section, and the upstream crsrc asset with license attribution.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite pins the probe contracts the ladder depends on (resolve-not-reject, MSE-door agreement, malformed refusal); 8/8 pass in the verification browser.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP-driven headless Chromium 141: rung 1 renders both isTypeSupported answers (false/false) and the ladder stops with the honest blocked explanation, rungs 2-6 stay 'not run yet', console/network clean; asset served 200 video/mp4 117384 bytes; desktop and mobile screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Success asserts iamf-mse-playback with duration/currentTime; every stop rung asserts iamf-mse-blocked with the rung and reason; autoplay-block asserts its own id.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; rung badges use the darkened-emerald/rose/muted trio on ivory (AA); button follows the global dark pattern.

accessibility.rationale: The ladder is a labelled list with textual per-rung state (badge glyphs are backed by adjacent text), the video has controls and an aria-label, and the outcome line is role=status aria-live=polite.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: After adding overflow-wrap:anywhere to rung titles (scrollWidth 395 to 360 at 360x740 DPR3), both classes lay out cleanly; verified by CDP measurement and responsive-check.

openQuestions.title: Execute rungs 2-6 on an IAMF-enabled Chromium
openQuestions.detail: The success path (fetch, append, endOfStream, play with advancing currentTime) has never run in a real browser here because no available build decodes IAMF. When Chrome 153+/an iamf-tools build with --enable-features=IamfAudioDecoding is available, run the full ladder, confirm currentTime advances and the iamf-mse-playback assert passes, and update this critique's edge_cases to pass.

guidanceConsulted.query: audio playback controls loading error retry states media
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Expose stepwise async progress as text, keep native media controls, and never communicate state by colour or icon alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each rung has a text outcome beside its glyph, the video element keeps native controls, and the ladder re-runs cleanly (button re-enabled in finally) as the retry path.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP run: rung-1 stop rendered as text; button re-enabled after run

guidanceConsulted.query: audio playback controls loading error retry states media
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Do not fetch large media until it can actually be used.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The 117 KB asset is fetched only after the rung-1 probe passes; unsupported browsers get a download link instead of an automatic fetch.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Verified: on the rung-1 stop no fetch request was issued (network log clean)

summary: Practical angle: the real streaming-site pipeline against Chromium's own test asset, with a six-rung ladder that stops honestly. Verified via CDP-driven headless Chromium 141 (sanctioned cloud fallback): honest rung-1 stop with both probe answers rendered, no fetch on the blocked path, asset served correctly, clean console/network. The success path is runtime-unreachable until an IAMF-enabled build exists — recorded as the open question rather than simulated.
